comment: The Coronal Mass Ejection (CME) associated with a filament eruption on 8-AUG arrived yesterday leading to minor enhancements in the solar wind parameters. Geomagnetic conditions were generally QUIET to ACTIVE in response and expected during the next two intervals. A high speed stream from a northern coronal hole is due to arrive by the 3rd interval and activity is expected to reach ACTIVE to STORM G1 levels as a result.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
